Amendment 0001 – Government Responses to RFIs, Revised Solicitation Documents, and Proposal Submission Deadline Extension  

 The purpose of this amendment is to provide the Government’s responses to Requests for Information (RFIs), incorporate revised and supplemental solicitation documents, and extend the proposal submission deadline. 

 1. Attachment 8, “Department of Energy – National Nuclear Security Administration Joint Cyber Facility Request for Information Log,” dated November 25, 2026, has been incorporated into the solicitation. 

 2. In connection with the Government’s responses to the RFIs, the following revised and supplemental documents have been incorporated into the solicitation and, where applicable, supersede their previously issued versions: 

 
	 RFI-020: 06.3_2_DOE NNSA JCF_Owners Project Requirements_AMD-1_20261124 
	 RFI-036, RFI-038, RFI-065, RFI-066, RFI-093, and RFI-103: 06.1_2a_DOE NNSA JCF_ADDENDUM 1_20261125 
	 RFI-060:
	 
		 0.6.4_1a_BIM Submission QC Checklist_v2025.1 
		 0.6.4_2a_GSA, CDX, and COBie Data Standard_v2025.1 
	 
	 
 

  3. The proposal submission deadline has been extended from December 7, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. (Mountain Time) to December 21, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. (Mountain Time).  

 4. A forthcoming solicitation amendment, anticipated to be issued during the week of November 30, 2026, will incorporate additional revisions to the applicable specifications and drawings. RFIs associated with these revisions are identified in Attachment 8 as “To Be Addressed in a Forthcoming Amendment.” No further extension of the proposal submission deadline is anticipated. 

 5. Offerors shall review the documents associated with this amendment and acknowledge receipt in accordance with Block 11 of the SF 30. 

 6. The Site Visit Attendance Log is also being made available for informational purposes and has been uploaded to the Attachments/Links section of this solicitation notice. 

 7. A revised Standard Form (SF) 1442 reflecting the extended proposal submission deadline has been uploaded for administrative convenience. Offerors should utilize the revised SF 1442 when preparing and submitting their proposals. Offerors remain responsible for acknowledging receipt of all solicitation amendments. 

 Except as expressly amended herein, all other terms, conditions, and requirements of the solicitation remain unchanged. 

 ______________________________________________________ 

  Project Title:  Department Of Energy - National Nuclear Security Administration Joint Cyber Facility 

  Project Location:  Building 810, Denver Federal Center, Lakewood, Colorado 80225  

  NAICS:  236220, Commercial & Institutional Building Construction 

  Estimated Price Range : Between $10 and $20 million 

  1. Project Summary:  The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA), intends to procure construction services for a design-bid-build project for the development of a Joint Cyber Facility (JCF) for the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA) at the Denver Federal Center in Lakewood, Colorado. 

 This requirement for a new turnkey JCF consists of approximately 23,688 square feet of combined office and support space, including approximately 16,000 square feet of finished office workspace and 7,688 square feet of existing mechanical and electrical rooms supporting the space. The project includes integration of existing equipment from a prior data center installation. The finished space includes a reception area, offices, conference rooms, hoteling cubicles, pantry, server room, and a large video conferencing room. 

 Construction and tenant build-out will occur within an occupied facility, necessitating careful coordination with active surrounding tenants. Work includes, demolition, architectural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, telecommunications, audio visual system infrastructure, security infrastructure, equipment, and coordinating installation of system furniture components, all of which must strictly adhere to accreditation requirements and standards. 

  2. Solicitation Documents and Access Requirements  

  NOTICE: Project-related documents, including drawings, specifications, and other supporting technical information, are available. To receive a copy of the scope of work documents, offerors must first complete the provided CUI Information Request Form (Request for Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI)) and any required Business License Form and submit the completed/signed forms to the Contracting Officer at    jamie.potter@gsa.gov   .  

  After submitting the required forms, offerors must request access to the controlled documents through    SAM.gov   . Access will be granted through    SAM.gov    to offerors that have submitted properly completed forms and requested access to the controlled documents.  

  3. Pre-Proposal Conference / Site Visit  

  Date:  Thursday, November 12, 2026 

  Location:  Building 810 Lobby, Denver Federal Center, Lakewood, Colorado 

  RSVP Deadline:  Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. (Mountain Time) 

  RSVP Registration Link:  https://forms.gle/SL5GCKVBnby2Bb7j6      

 Interested offerors planning to attend the site visit  must RSVP using the registration link provided above  no later than the specified deadline. 

 4.  Questions and Clarifications  

 All questions regarding the solicitation shall be submitted in writing via email to the Contracting Officer no later than  Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. Mountain Time . 

 Questions received after the deadline may not be considered. The Government anticipates issuing responses to timely submitted questions through a solicitation amendment. 

  5. Proposal Submission  

  Proposal Due Date:  Monday, December 7, 2026 

  Proposal Due Time:  11:00 a.m. Mountain Time 

 Offerors shall submit proposals in accordance with the instructions and require
